marketing.downloadPanelSubtitle: Choose the build that matches your device
marketing.downloadPageSubtitle: Choose the build that matches your device and start creating faster
marketing.heroTitle: Ship content from idea to publish—in chat
marketing.heroSubtitle: Chat powers the full flow: personas, trend expansion, drafting, and publishing. Supports chat-direct publishing, in-doc manual publishing, and scheduled auto-runs.
marketing.spotlightsSubtitle: Built for faster output with higher consistency: chat creation at the core, personas and trends for quality, smart visuals and publishing for execution.
marketing.spotlightChatDesc: The core capability: complete persona setup, topic expansion, drafting, rewriting, and publish decisions in one continuous chat.
marketing.spotlightPersonaDesc: Describe tone, audience, and guardrails in chat so every draft sounds like the same brand voice.
marketing.spotlightTopicsDesc: Drop a trend or keyword and iterate angles, outlines, and examples—still in conversation.
marketing.spotlightImageDesc: Use AI image generation, web image search, or your asset library, then let the system place suitable visuals into the draft automatically.
marketing.spotlightPublishDesc: Publish in two ways: send by chat command to target accounts, or edit in-document and publish manually.
marketing.spotlightAutomationDesc: Set task name, prompt, publishing accounts, and schedule notes, then let the system create and publish automatically on cadence.
marketing.audienceTitle: Built for anyone who needs an information edge
marketing.audienceSubtitle: Whether you run content, growth, or operations, MediaBee helps you create and publish with consistency.
marketing.audience1Desc: Track industry moves and competitor signals quickly, so decision time goes to what matters most.
marketing.audience2Desc: Produce at scale around trends with consistent persona voice and reliable output quality.
marketing.audience3Desc: Turn user feedback and market signals into content experiments that support roadmap and growth.
marketing.audience4Desc: Turn scattered ideas into repeatable columns and publish steadily to grow your personal brand.
marketing.choosePoint1Title: Fast to start, steady to run
marketing.choosePoint1Desc: Start from chat, then move from idea to publish with a clear flow that scales for teams.
marketing.choosePoint2Desc: Use manual confirmation or scheduled plans, with centralized control of key assets and data.
marketing.testimonialsSubtitle: Feedback from real operators and creators
marketing.testimonial1Quote: Our team used to lose hours on topic picking and rewrites. Now we expand trends in chat and draft with personas in one flow.
marketing.testimonial2Quote: Execution is the key. Once scheduled plans are configured, the system runs creation and publishing on time with minimal supervision.
marketing.testimonial3Quote: The visual workflow is a big win. AI images, web search, and library assets all work together, and insertion is automatic.
marketing.featuresSubtitle: Chat is the default interface: fewer panels, more momentum.
marketing.featuresPageLead: Personas, ideation, and drafting stay chat-first. Scheduled auto-publish is form-based—not chat: in “Create scheduled plan,” fill task name, prompt, publishing accounts, schedule notes, plus image mode, persona, and advanced options as needed, then save for cadence-based generation and delivery. Prefer not to automate? At publish time, open the publish flow, pick accounts and timing, and confirm each send manually.
marketing.feature1Desc: Turn a rough brief into structured drafts; iterate with rewrites, tone shifts, and platform-specific formatting.
marketing.feature2Desc: Capture personas in chat and reuse them so outputs stay on-brand for teams.
marketing.feature3Desc: Assets and works connect to chat—reference media, save versions, and reuse winning paragraphs.
marketing.feature4Desc: Chat and automation consume credits; allowances are clear in-app with concurrency-friendly tiers.
marketing.feature5Desc: Same creation and publishing capabilities across web and desktop—continue any thread.
marketing.feature6Desc: Matches your in-app appearance preference for long chat and editing sessions.
marketing.guideSubtitle: Personas, topics, and drafts mainly in chat; publishing via scheduled-plan forms—or manual confirmation in the publish UI before send.
marketing.guidePageLead: A common path below; jump into chat for a sub-task anytime; open the scheduled-plan form separately when you want automation.
marketing.guideStep1Desc: Open the creation workspace from the sidebar and start a new chat—your command center.
marketing.guideStep2Desc: Ask for a Zhihu-style explainer persona or a Toutiao tech channel voice, then feed a trend to expand angles; keep chatting until it’s ready to draft.
marketing.guideStep3Desc: Specify platform, length, structure, or references—then rewrite, add examples, and sanity-check tone.
marketing.guideStep4Title: Publishing: scheduled plans or manual send
marketing.guideStep4Desc: Automation: create a scheduled plan—fill task name, prompt, publishing accounts, schedule notes, and save for the system to run on cadence. Manual: only at publish time—use the publish flow to choose accounts, timing, and confirm each send.
marketing.guideStep5Desc: Save sources and final versions to libraries for faster team sharing and reuse.
marketing.guideStep6Desc: Open Subscription from your profile menu and choose monthly or annual billing.
marketing.pricingSubtitle: Three tiers aligned with in-app plans. Feature overview below; live prices are shown inside the app.
marketing.pricingPageLead: Credits power chat creation and scheduled-plan automation (including cadence-based generation and publish steps). Final amounts are shown in-app.
marketing.pricingFootnote: Prices and promotions may change; see the in-app purchase dialog for current amounts and invoices.
marketing.faqPageLead: Common questions about chat creation, auto-publish, credits, and accounts.
marketing.faq1A: Core chat creation and publishing require signing in. Browse these pages first, then register or log in in the app.
marketing.faq2A: Chat generation, tool calls, scheduled-plan runs, and publish-related steps consume credits per rules—see in-app details.
marketing.faq3A: We currently support Toutiao, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu, Baijiahao, and CSDN; capabilities and account linking are shown in-app.
marketing.faq4A: Use official downloads and channels. Follow your org’s compliance policies and back up important assets and finals.
marketing.faq5Q: Can I mix auto-publish and manual publishing?
marketing.faq5A: Yes. Auto-publish comes from scheduled-plan forms, not chat. “Manual” means you confirm in the publish UI—accounts, timing, and sends—while earlier creation stays chat-first.
